title: Return invalidProperties for chatId non-member on create
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Return invalidProperties for chatId non-member on create
Spec (3cbb0c4): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L619: "When `chatId` does not resolve to a Chat object, the server MUST return `invalidProperties` naming `chatId`. The server SHOULD return the same error when the caller is not a member of that Chat, so that the response does not reveal that the Chat exists."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:92-94; crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:44-55
Now: check_call_create returns forbidden("the caller is not a member of the Chat") for a non-member. The doc comment quotes the removed MUST-forbidden text.
Change: Return SetError invalidProperties with properties ["chatId"] and the same description as the not-found case. Update the doc quotes; start_call staying forbidden is still correct.
